notes.title: The verifier flags fixes that silence checkers.
notes.body: Two fixes passed their tests but added a lint or type-check suppression. The verifier flagged both for review; Devin removed the suppressions and both fixes were proven again without them.

notes.title: A gap in the verifier sent one bug to an engineer, and a one-line fix brought it back.
notes.body: The verifier did not recognise Superset's `*_tests.py` test files, so the first fix for #4 could not be proven and hit the retry limit. After the fix, the retry was proven: 6 of 1,210 tests fail before, all pass after.

notes.title: Devin speaks for the work; the service only moves labels and statuses.
notes.body: Every comment on these bugs comes from Devin's own GitHub account. The service needs nothing but the operator's token.

notes.title: Polling every bug each minute is expensive.
notes.body: Re-reading every tracked bug and pull request once a minute used a token's 5,000 GitHub requests an hour. Webhooks or conditional requests are the next step.
